correction.result: No remaining concrete blocker in the scoped source and modeled review.
correction.behavior: Request-only token lookup; nonprepared/expired results expose state only without invoice reads; current invoice must match original project/client and active client before paid status or payable fields; prepared hash and display derive from one captured invoice row; all dynamic fields escaped; terminal states show no stale amount.
correction.preserved: Original readiness, token format, rate, noindex/no-referrer/no-store headers, generic 404 and shell remain. All unrelated payment source and original native assertions are unchanged under finite text inverses.
correction.snapshot_limit: The modeled mutation proves no second unchecked invoice metadata fetch. It is not evidence of serializable atomicity across separate catalog/ledger queries or a native concurrent transaction.
